title: Did Not Go to Print
statement: The task is to replay n printer commands where memory is a stack: '1' at step i pushes document i, '2' pops and prints the top (or prints document i if memory is empty), and '3' prints document i. It asks for every never-printed index, n up to 2·10^5. Unprinted documents are those left in the stack plus each '2' step whose memory was non-empty, found in one O(n) pass.
